UAT queue.jql: project = ITROLL AND status = "In UAT" ORDER BY priority DESC

High risks.jql: project = ITROLL AND labels = risk AND "Risk rating" ~ "High" AND statusCategory != Done

Blocked.jql: project = ITROLL AND (labels = blocked OR Flagged = Impediment) AND statusCategory != Done

Open risks.jql: project = ITROLL AND labels = risk AND statusCategory != Done
